articles.title: Chicago Cubs reliever Ryan Rolison’s spring training buy-in has led the lefty to a big bullpen role
articles.description: Ryan Rolison has seized his opportunity with the Chicago Cubs after earning a mid-April call-up. Entering Tuesday, he owns a 2.89 ERA and 146 ERA+ in 52 appearances.

articles.title: Chicago Cubs updates: Dansby Swanson progressing with injury — and Javier Assad gets nod to start Saturday
articles.description: Dansby Swanson’s unfamiliarity with an oblique strain creates a little uncertainty for the Chicago Cubs shortstop about what his path back might entail.

articles.title: How the Chicago Cubs’ outfield approach is helping them lead MLB in preventing extra bases
articles.description: Opposing teams are clearly respecting the arms of the Chicago Cubs’ starting outfield — Ian Happ, Pete Crow-Armstrong and Seiya Suzuki — with the lowest percentage of advance attempts.

articles.title: Column: It’s hard to call Milwaukee Brewers a surprise when they keep finishing ahead of Chicago Cubs
articles.description: The Chicago Cubs probably can’t catch the Milwaukee Brewers in the National League Central, but can they still make noise in October?

articles.title: Javier Assad battles through season-high 5 walks and bullpen does enough to seal Chicago Cubs’ 6-5 win
articles.description: In his first big-league start in a month, Javier Assad grinded through 4 2/3 innings Saturday against the Miami Marlins, ultimately limiting enough damage in the Chicago Cubs’ 6-5 win.

articles.title: Just do it: Riding his splitter, new-look Shota Imanaga handcuffs Miami Marlins in Chicago Cubs’ 6-1 win
articles.description: Sporting a new, shorter hairdo, Shota Imanaga limited the Miami Marlins to one run on three hits in six-plus innings Friday in the Chicago Cubs’ 6-1 win.

articles.title: Caleb Williams watches Chicago Cubs beat Milwaukee Brewers 2-1
articles.description: Kevin Gausman struck out nine in seven innings and the Chicago Cubs beat the Milwaukee Brewers 2-1 on Thursday to earn a series split.

articles.title: Chicago Cubs’ offense and defense have led the way. Can the pitching staff be more consistent in September?
articles.description: The Chicago Cubs couldn’t hold their three-run lead as a four-run sixth inning by the Milwaukee Brewers delivered a big blow in a 9-4 loss Tuesday.

articles.title: Chicago Cubs outslug Milwaukee Brewers in 17-3 blowout win to cap NL record home run month
articles.description: The Chicago Cubs slugged a franchise record nine home runs in a 17-3 win over the Milwaukee Brewers, putting an exclamation point on a stellar month of power production.
